title: Take-Two Boss 'Not in the Least' Concerned GTA6 Launch Will Be Affected by Bad Press
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has stated he is not concerned that negative press surrounding Rockstar's employment tribunal will impact the launch of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Take-Two CEO Addresses Rockstar Labor Controversies

In recent statements, Take-Two Interactive CEO Strauss Zelnick addressed the media regarding ongoing controversies surrounding Rockstar Games. Specifically, Zelnick stated that he is "not in the least" concerned that the negative press stemming from alleged union-busting and recent employment tribunal issues will have any adverse effect on the highly anticipated launch of Grand Theft Auto 6.

## Industry Impact and Market Confidence

As Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two oversees the development of what is widely considered the most anticipated entertainment release in history. The ongoing discussions and employment tribunal reports focusing on workplace practices have drawn scrutiny from various media outlets and industry observers. However, Zelnick's dismissal of these concerns highlights a prevailing corporate confidence in the sheer gravitational pull of the GTA brand.

Historically, blockbuster video games of this magnitude possess immense resilience against external controversies. The immense consumer demand, record-breaking trailer view counts, and unwavering community excitement suggest that the commercial trajectory of GTA 6 remains largely insulated from non-gameplay-related public relations challenges.

## Editor's Take

Zelnick's firm stance reflects the immense commercial armor protecting top-tier franchises like GTA 6. While external controversies and labor disputes are serious matters that warrant industry-wide attention, the sheer magnitude of player anticipation ensures that the game's launch momentum will likely remain entirely unaffected.
